mechanism: Betamethasone may increase ranolazine metabolism via CYP3A4 induction, potentially reducing ranolazine efficacy; ranolazine is a weak CYP3A4 inhibitor with minimal reciprocal effect.
action: Monitor clinical efficacy of ranolazine; consider ECG monitoring as ranolazine prolongs QT interval and corticosteroids may cause electrolyte abnormalities that increase arrhythmia risk.
